La suite principale depuis la position a: Recall the main line from the current position (up to 40 half-moves). Go to the position before the first move to learn.
L’activité déjà enregistrée restera dans: Your recorded activity will remain in your progress.
La partie démarre depuis la position de: The game starts from the board position. Navigating moves stops the clock.
Le coup sélectionné et ses continuations: The selected move and its continuations will be removed.

Playing strength applies to games against Stockfish. Analysis uses full strength.

A personal workspace for your chess.
Version de développement 0.3.0. Les sauv: Development version 0.3.0. PGN and SQLite backups are recommended for important studies. The .t64 format is experimental.
Le nom d’ouverture sélectionne les codes: Opening names select ECO codes from the Lichess catalog, not an exact variation. Use the board position for that. Elo filters exclude unknown ratings. Material is searched in all variations.
Pièces : C. M. L. Burnett et A. Hernande: Pieces: C. M. L. Burnett and A. Hernandez Marroquin (GPL-2.0+), Maurizio Monge (MIT), therealqtpi (AGPL-3.0+). Choices are saved automatically.
Statistiques calculées depuis les partie: Statistics calculated from games in your local library.
Placez l’échiquier sur la position à pré: Set the board to the position you want to prepare. Continuations are calculated from games matching the filters.
Une borne Elo active exclut les parties: An active Elo bound excludes games with either rating missing; an active date range excludes unknown years. No Elo is estimated.
No continuation prepared for this position.
Une partie compte une fois par coup, que: A game counts once per move, regardless of move order or repetitions. These frequencies describe the selected database; they establish neither a move’s quality nor its theoretical novelty.
Préparez une étude avec ses variantes, p: Prepare a study with variations, then create your repertoire.
Réponses adverses présentes dans la bibl: Opponent replies present in the library but missing from the repertoire, sorted by frequency (up to 100). Absence does not establish a theoretical novelty.
Aucune réponse manquante trouvée dans la: No missing replies found in the local database.
Positions où au moins un rappel a échoué: Positions with at least one failed recall. This tracks memorization of your prepared moves, not their chess quality.
Toutes les variantes accessibles de l’ét: All reachable study variations are added. Transpositions share replies and reviews.
Les coups préparés et leurs révisions se: Prepared moves and reviews will be deleted. Library games will be kept.
Les suites devenues inaccessibles seront: Unreachable continuations will be removed. Reachable transpositions keep their reviews.
Une copie de toutes les variantes est tr: A copy of all variations is sent to the analysis queue. Each transposition position is expanded once. Your notes and reviews are kept.
Ajouter une copie de l’étude ouverte à l: Add a copy of the open study to the queue
Les résultats sont sauvegardés à chaque: Results are saved at every position. After an interruption, choose Resume. WDL is the engine’s estimate from White’s perspective, not a prediction of your result.
Interrompu ou actif dans une autre insta: Interrupted or active in another instance
Sélectionnez une analyse pour voir ses r: Select an analysis to view its results.
Results will be removed from the queue. The original game is kept.
Sélectionnez 2 à 4 profils enregistrés d: Select 2 to 4 profiles saved in settings. Each engine analyzes the same position using its MultiPV and Syzygy tables.
Enregistrez au moins deux profils UCI po: Save at least two UCI profiles to start.
La comparaison suit la navigation de l’é: Comparison follows board navigation. Resources are limited to 1 GiB total hash, sharing the available processors.
Démarrez le moteur pour lire ses options: Start the engine to read its options.
Appliquez les changements avec « Démarre: Apply changes with “Start / apply”, then save the profile. Strength limits apply only to playing games.
Les parties sont conservées par lots de: Games are saved in batches of 250. After a pause or crash, resumption starts at the last committed batch. The entire file is verified with SHA-256 before every resumption.
Retirer un import de cette liste conserv: Removing an import from this list keeps all its games in the library. The standard import remains available for full cancellation.
Aucun import PGN enregistré depuis cette: No PGN imports recorded since this version.
Calcul local. Vous pouvez fermer cette f: Local calculation. You can close this window and keep working.
Evaluations from White’s perspective. Click the graph or a move to revisit the position.
Seuils indicatifs : 50 / 100 / 250 centi: Indicative thresholds: 50 / 100 / 250 centipawns. Results depend on the engine and thinking time; exercises follow its main variation.
Ouvrir la suite dans une nouvelle étude: Open continuation in a new study
Suite limitée aux 128 premiers demi-cou: Continuation limited to the first 128 half-moves.
Motifs observés, sans garantie de gain f: Observed patterns do not guarantee a forced win. In the copy: green arrows show attacks, yellow marks show pin/skewer alignments. The engine line may change; repetitions before the diagram are not reproduced.
Demi-coups sans prise ni pion: Half-moves without capture or pawn move
. Pion = 1, cavalier/fou = 3, tour = 5,: . Pawn = 1, knight/bishop = 3, rook = 5, queen = 9. This count does not measure position quality.
Téléchargements à la demande. Les moteur: Downloads on demand. Engines are verified before installation and do not start automatically. Imported databases work offline.
Empreinte enregistrée à réception ; le: Hash recorded upon receipt; the provider does not publish SHA-256.
Binaire incompatible avec ce système ; g: Binary incompatible with this system; glibc ≥
Empreinte non enregistrée pour cet impor: No hash recorded for this local import.
Les fichiers téléchargés seront supprimé: Downloaded files will be deleted. Imported games and profile settings will be kept. A profile with a deleted engine will need a new executable.
Stable reçoit uniquement les versions st: Stable receives published stable releases only. Beta includes beta prereleases; Development includes tested development builds.
Connectez gh avec « gh auth login », pui: Sign in with “gh auth login”, then enable this option. Alternatively, use a token restricted to Trait64 with read-only Contents permission, kept for this session only.

Home / End: start / end of line
Aucun livre Polyglot (.bin) : indiquez-l: No Polyglot book (.bin): set one in Settings.
Parties publiques uniquement, sans compt: Public games only, no account needed. On Lichess, a new import only fetches games played since the previous one.
Toutes rondes entre 2 et 8 profils enreg: Round robin between 2 and 8 saved profiles. Each pair plays both colours from the same opening; games are added to the library.
Enregistrez au moins deux profils UCI da: Save at least two UCI profiles in Settings to run a tournament.
Ouvertures tirées du livre Polyglot: Openings drawn from the Polyglot book
« Elo ± » est l'écart estimé face au res: "Elo ±" is the estimated gap against the rest of the field. Over few games the error margin often exceeds 100 Elo.
Parties qui atteignent la structure de p: Games reaching the board's pawn structure, whatever the other pieces.
Chaque puzzle est choisi près de votre c: Each puzzle is picked near your rating, which moves like an Elo. On the last move any mate is accepted. A hint or the solution counts as a failure.
Environ 5 millions de puzzles notés, sou: About 5 million rated puzzles, CC0 licensed. Download “lichess_db_puzzle.csv.zst” (≈ 280 MB) from the site, then import it here: the compressed file is read directly.
Montre la pièce à jouer ; compte comme u: Shows the piece to move; counts as a failure.
Ses plus faibles scores, sur au moins tr: Lowest scores, over at least three finished games.
Ajoute jusqu’à 200 parties correspondant: Adds up to 200 games matching the current library filters (main lines).
Un livre .bin des coups joués au moins d: A .bin book of moves played at least twice in the library, weighted by games played.
Ajouter cette ligne à l’étude: Add this line to the study
Un passage rapide du début à la fin, pui: A quick pass from start to end, then a full pass from the end back to the start: the engine benefits from what it learnt about the rest of the game.
Vos parties publiques arrivent dans la b: Your public games arrive in the library, filed by account. Each sync only fetches games played since the previous one. No password is needed.
Retire le compte ; les parties déjà impo: Removes the account; games already imported stay.
Aucun compte pour l’instant : ajoutez le: No account yet: add yours below.
Bande verticale contre l’échiquier : la: A vertical strip against the board: the light part is White's advantage.
Réglable aussi à la molette, en maintena: Also adjustable with the wheel, holding Ctrl over the board.
Start the analysis to see the evaluation.
Review the game to see the curve.
Évaluations du point de vue des Blancs: Evaluations from White's point of view
Ouvrir le bilan complet : précision par: Open the full review: accuracy per phase, mistakes explained, exercises.
Stockfish depuis votre distribution, ou: Stockfish from your distribution, or an engine from the catalogue under Library → Downloads.
Votre processeur offre %1 cœurs. Trait64: Your processor offers %1 cores. Trait64 leaves one free so the machine stays responsive during analysis.
Table de hachage du moteur. Votre machin: Engine hash table. Your machine has %1 MiB.
Passe en revue les parties synchronisées: Reviews the synced games of this profile that have no review at this depth yet. Those already seen that deep are left alone.
Un profil rassemble vos comptes Lichess: A profile gathers your Lichess and Chess.com accounts and your FIDE record under one name, so your statistics cover all of your games.
Retire le profil ; les comptes et les pa: Removes the profile; the accounts and the games remain.
Un « ? » marque un classement que la der: A “?” marks a rating the last list consulted did not confirm: the player was no longer in it for that speed.
Aucun compte rattaché : utilisez « Ratta: No account attached: use “Attach” on an account below.
Nom du profil, par exemple votre prénom: Profile name, for example your first name
Votre identifiant figure sur votre fiche: Your identifier is on your record at ratings.fide.com. Leave a speed at zero if you are not rated in it.
Trait64 peut aussi lire vos classements: Trait64 can also read your ratings from the monthly lists published by the federation. Each speed is a download of several tens of megabytes: tick only those that concern you.
Le calcul se fait en arrière-plan et peu: The computation runs in the background and can be paused. Count about sixty positions per game: a large batch takes several hours.
Profondeur %1, au plus %2 ms par positio: Depth %1, at most %2 ms per position. Games already seen that deep are skipped.
Create a profile to follow your progress.
Écart entre votre mois le plus récent et: Difference between your most recent month and the average of your earlier months.
Réussite sur vos 50 derniers exercices,: Success over your last 50 exercises, %1 solved in all.
Résolvez des exercices pour mesurer votr: Solve exercises to measure your tactics.
Les notes dépendent du moteur et de la p: Marks depend on the engine and the depth requested: compare reviews run at the same settings. Overall accuracy is weighted by the number of moves; the phase figures are a per-game average.
Prend l’étude ouverte dans l’onglet Anal: Takes the study open in the Analysis tab, with all its variations.
Ajoute les lignes d’un fichier à l’étude: Adds the lines of a file to the chosen study, variations and transpositions included.
Reprend un dossier d’études tel qu’En Cr: Takes a study folder as En Croissant or Pawn Appétit leaves it: one study per PGN file, subfolders included.
Éditer les coups préparés, la couverture: Edit the prepared moves, the coverage and the answers to prepare.
Aucune étude pour l’instant. Importez un: No study yet. Import a folder from another program, or create one from the open study.
Choose a study from the list.
Fusionne l’étude de l’onglet Analyse dan: Merges the study from the Analysis tab into this one, with its variations.
Une étude est un PGN : ce que vous expor: A study is a PGN: what you export here reads back in En Croissant, Pawn Appétit or any chess program.
Ajouter un PGN à cette étude: Add a PGN to this study
Reprendre où vous en étiez, ouvrir une p: Pick up where you left off, open a sample game.
Échiquier, notation, moteur et bilan de: Board, notation, engine and the review of the current game.
Vos bases : importer du PGN, chercher, t: Your databases: import PGN, search, sort, back up.
Arbre statistique de votre base, livres: Statistical tree of your database, books and repertoires.
Constituer un dossier contre un adversai: Build a dossier against a given opponent.
Choisir le moteur, sa puissance et ses v: Choose the engine, its power and its variations.
Fiches des joueurs de votre base et de v: Records of the players in your database and your accounts.
Vos comptes sous un seul nom, le bilan d: Your accounts under one name, the review of your games and your progress.
Vos répertoires : les créer, les réviser: Your repertoires: create them, review them, import those from another program.
Comparer des moteurs, organiser un tourn: Compare engines, run a tournament, play a game.
Apparence, langue, moteur, sauvegardes e: Appearance, language, engine, backups and updates.

Donne à chaque partie la collection de s: Gives every game the collection of its opening family, from its ECO code. Nothing to download; games without an ECO code are left unchanged.
Rattachez un compte à ce profil pour mes: Link an account to this profile to measure your games.
